records.scope: Current candidate3 workflow: preparation, traditional CBMC, CompCert export, proof construction/retries/repair/kernel checks, reports and coordinator acceptance.

time.rule: Direct enclosing interval, not sum of overlapping workers; startup event interval separately shown.

measurement_limitations: Recorded GNU time/RSS values are tool-process observations, excluding model-server/desktop memory.
Early Ctrl-C and one timeout lost CPU/RSS receipts; short inspection commands missed10ms samples.
Some bootstrap and metadata-wrapper operations were outside resource wrappers. Full CPU cannot be recovered.
Parallel workers lacked a joint RSS observer; observed worker maximum is not the workflow simultaneous peak.
Whole resources remain null with reasons; all original failures, audits and observed subsets are retained.
Token totals stop at the stated receipts; final response transport after closure is excluded.
